content: - We measure the performance of the systems at predicting the sensitive information type of each token –i.e., the 11 categories presented in Section SECREF5 or `out'. Detecting entity types correctly is important if a system is going to be used to replace sensitive data by fake data of the same type (e.g., random people names).
